summary: Version 2 quietly shortens the landlord's termination notice from 15 days to 7 days. Nothing else changed.

changes.beforeText: The Landlord may terminate this Agreement at any time by giving fifteen (15) days' notice.
changes.afterText: The Landlord may terminate this Agreement at any time by giving seven (7) days' notice.
changes.explanation: The landlord's notice to end the agreement dropped from 15 days to 7 days, while your own notice period stays at three months.
changes.whyItMatters: You would have even less time to find a new place if the landlord ends the agreement. This change was not mentioned elsewhere, so it is worth asking about directly.
